title: Rain on glass: droplets, running trails and mist
purpose: Generate tileable maps of rain on a window: droplets in three size classes as merging domes, running drops that leave meandering trails and beads, and condensation mist wiped clear by them, with an alpha overlay and a normal map for refraction. Use for windows, windscreens, visors and wet camera lenses.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python rain_on_glass.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: trails
parameters.meaning: Running drops that leave trails down the glass.

parameters.name: beading
parameters.meaning: Beads left behind along the trails.

parameters.name: mist
parameters.meaning: Fine condensation misting the glass, wiped clear by trails and large drops.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the drop bulges in the normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Steady rain: mixed droplets and a few trails with beads.

presets.name: drizzle
presets.description: Fine drizzle: many small drops and no trails.

presets.name: downpour
presets.description: Downpour: large merging drops and many long trails.

presets.name: misted
presets.description: Misted window: condensation wiped into clear streaks by running drops.

limits: A still frame: drops do not move, and trails run down the tile and wrap around it, so a repeating tile repeats its trails. Drops are domes of a fixed profile merged by taking the higher one, not a fluid simulation, and the lighting painted into the albedo assumes light from the upper left. Refraction needs a glass shader that offsets the background by the normal map; the albedo alone only darkens rims and lights one side. Drops smaller than half a pixel are drawn at that size with less height.
technique_references: Jittered grid placement in three size classes
Flattened power-of-dome height stamps merged by maximum
Random-walk trails painted as capsules with beads
Fractional Brownian motion mist wiped by trail and drop masks
Slope-based rim darkening and directional highlight
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
